name: hud_ui_triplet_panel_draw
description: HudUiTripletPanel::Draw calls the base DrawBase slot and draws visible child widgets in reverse item order.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x40f400 show the base ftable slot 2 DrawBase dispatch followed by child item slots processed from index 2 down to 0, skipping items with hidden flag bit 0x10 set.
The native triplet-panel draw smoke verifies base DrawBase dispatch and visible child Draw calls in item order 2 then 0 while skipping hidden item 1.
